title: 安蓓萨·赤披风之阶
description: 银白卷发安蓓萨稳立宽阔石阶，双刃垂放不挥舞，深红披风与金属肩甲被侧后光勾亮。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Ambessa is a powerful older dark-skinned woman with silver-white curls, a lined dignified face, broad shoulders, and dark Noxian armor accented by red cloth and metal. Preserve her mature age, commanding expression, and substantial adult physique. Fully covering armor and opaque trousers conceal torso and legs; her paired curved drakehound blades are held low, their linking elements gathered without tension.
art_direction.scene: Show her standing on a vast staircase before an undecorated fortress wall, gaze directed beyond the viewer's shoulder. The weapons remain lowered outside her silhouette, and her feet are clearly planted. Hard light from behind one shoulder creates a narrow copper rim, while broad dark crayon facets describe the armor and a simple red cape cuts across the steps.
art_direction.palette: burgundy, dark iron, silver curls, copper light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
